description: Search FincaRaiz.com.co property listings by city, operation, property type, price, rooms, area and stratum.

areaMax.description: Largest property area in square metres. Leave blank for no maximum.
areaMax.title: Maximum Area (m²)

areaMin.description: Smallest property area in square metres. Leave blank for no minimum.
areaMin.title: Minimum Area (m²)

bathroomsMax.description: Largest number of bathrooms. Leave blank for no maximum.
bathroomsMax.title: Maximum Bathrooms

bathroomsMin.description: Smallest number of bathrooms. Leave blank for no minimum.
bathroomsMin.title: Minimum Bathrooms

bedroomsMax.description: Largest number of bedrooms. Leave blank for no maximum.
bedroomsMax.title: Maximum Bedrooms

bedroomsMin.description: Smallest number of bedrooms. Use 0 for studios. Leave blank for no minimum.
bedroomsMin.title: Minimum Bedrooms

city.description: Colombian city or municipality, for example Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena, Bucaramanga or Pereira. Leave blank to search all of Colombia.
city.title: City

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property listings to return (1-1000).
maxItems.title: Max Results

mode.description: Choose properties for sale (Venta) or for rent (Arriendo).
mode.title: Operation

priceMax.description: Highest asking price in Colombian Pesos (COP). Leave blank for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum Price (COP)

priceMin.description: Lowest asking price in Colombian Pesos (COP). Leave blank for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum Price (COP)

propertyType.description: Filter by property type. Leave on All Types to search every kind of property.
propertyType.title: Property Type

sortOrder.description: Order of the listings returned by FincaRaiz.
sortOrder.title: Sort Results By

stratum.description: Colombian socioeconomic stratum (estrato) from 1 to 6. Leave on Any Stratum to include every stratum.
stratum.title: Socioeconomic Stratum
